<script>
    /* =====================================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles: keyboard, touch, wheel navigation;
                intersection observer for reveal animations;
                progress bar and nav dots;
                bar chart animation on entry.
       ===================================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides        = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide  = 0;
            this.barsAnimated  = false;

            this.progressBar   = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsEl     = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.buildNavDots();
            this.setupObserver();
            this.setupKeyboard();
            this.setupTouch();
            this.setupWheel();
        }

        /* --- Navigation dots --- */
        buildNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsEl.appendChild(btn);
            });
        }

        updateDots() {
            this.navDotsEl.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((d, i) => {
                d.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
            });
        }

        /* --- IntersectionObserver: adds .visible class for reveal animations --- */
        setupObserver() {
            const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
                    const slide = entry.target;
                    slide.classList.add('visible');
                    this.currentSlide = this.slides.indexOf(slide);
                    this.updateDots();
                    this.updateProgress();
                    if (slide.id === 'slide-7') {
                        setTimeout(() => this.animateBars(), 250);
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(s => obs.observe(s));
        }

        /* --- Progress bar --- */
        updateProgress() {
            const pct = (this.currentSlide / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100;
            if (this.progressBar) this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* --- Keyboard navigation --- */
        setupKeyboard() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight': case ' ': case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentSlide + 1); break;
                    case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft': case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentSlide - 1); break;
                    case 'Home': e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(0); break;
                    case 'End':  e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1); break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* --- Touch / swipe navigation --- */
        setupTouch() {
            let startY = 0, startX = 0;
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
                startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });
            document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const dx = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 48) {
                    this.goTo(dy > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Mouse wheel navigation (debounced) --- */
        setupWheel() {
            let last = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - last < 750) return;
                last = now;
                this.goTo(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        goTo(idx) {
            if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* --- Bar chart animation (slide 7) ---
             Heights are set as percentages of the bars-area container height.
             The container has an explicit computed height (via clamp), so
             percentage heights on child elements resolve correctly. */
        animateBars() {
            if (this.barsAnimated) return;
            this.barsAnimated = true;

            const set = (id, value) => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.style.height = (value * 100) + '%';
            };

            set('bs-sft', 0.639);
            set('bs-dpo', 0.917);
            set('br-sft', 0.826);
            set('br-dpo', 0.913);
        }
    }

    new SlidePresentation();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>

    <!-- Fonts: Syne (display) + IBM Plex Sans (body) + IBM Plex Mono (code/data) -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;600;700;800&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
        /* === CSS CUSTOM PROPERTIES (THEME) ===
           Deep-space navy × teal × amber — technical ML aesthetic
           Change the values here to retheme the entire deck. */
        :root {
            /* Backgrounds */
            --bg-primary:    #060c18;
            --bg-secondary:  #0b1525;
            --bg-card:       #0f1e35;
            --bg-card-alt:   #132240;

            /* Borders */
            --border-subtle: rgba(0, 210, 180, 0.10);
            --border-accent: rgba(0, 210, 180, 0.30);
            --border-dim:    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);

            /* Accent palette */
            --accent-teal:   #00d4b0;
            --accent-amber:  #f0a020;
            --accent-coral:  #ff6060;
            --accent-blue:   #5ba4ff;

            /* Text */
            --text-primary:   #e6eefc;
            --text-secondary: #7a9cc5;
            --text-muted:     #405870;

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Syne', sans-serif;
            --font-body:    'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
            --font-mono:    'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;

            /* Font sizes — ALL use clamp() */
            --title-size:   clamp(1.8rem,  4.8vw, 3.8rem);
            --h2-size:      clamp(1.25rem, 2.8vw, 2.1rem);
            --h3-size:      clamp(0.9rem,  1.8vw, 1.35rem);
            --body-size:    clamp(0.72rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            --small-size:   clamp(0.62rem, 0.9vw, 0.78rem);
            --table-size:   clamp(0.58rem, 0.82vw, 0.74rem);

            /* Spacing */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap:   clamp(0.6rem, 1.4vw, 1.4rem);

            /* Animation easing */
            --ease-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

            /* Glow helpers */
            --glow-teal:  0 0 28px rgba(0, 212, 176, 0.22);
            --glow-amber: 0 0 20px rgba(240, 160, 32,  0.18);
        }

        /* === BASE RESET === */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* ===================================================
           VIEWPORT-BASE.CSS (full contents included inline)
           Mandatory responsive viewport-fitting styles.
           =================================================== */

        html, body { height: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* Each slide = exact viewport height */
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Content container */
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list { gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem); }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li { font-size: var(--body-size); line-height: 1.4; }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* Breakpoint: short viewports < 700px */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.4rem,  1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(1rem,    3vw,   1.75rem);
            }
        }

        /* Breakpoint: very short viewports < 600px */
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem,  2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.3rem,  1vw,   0.75rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1.1rem,  4vw,   2rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.7rem,  1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        /* Breakpoint: landscape phones < 500px */
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw,   1rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1rem,   3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.65rem,1vw,   0.85rem);
            }
        }

        /* Breakpoint: narrow viewports < 600px width */
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* Reduced motion */
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration:  0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s  !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===================================================
           SHARED DECORATIVE / LAYOUT ELEMENTS
           =================================================== */

        /* Subtle grid pattern overlay for all slides */
        .bg-grid {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 212, 176, 0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 212, 176, 0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 64px 64px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* Soft ambient glow blobs */
        .bg-glow {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(90px);
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.45;
        }
        .bg-glow-teal  { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,212,176,0.28)  0%, transparent 70%); }
        .bg-glow-amber { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(240,160,32,0.22) 0%, transparent 70%); }
        .bg-glow-blue  { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(91,164,255,0.18) 0%, transparent 70%); }

        /* Progress bar (fixed top) */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-teal), var(--accent-amber));
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.35s ease;
            box-shadow: var(--glow-teal);
            width: 0;
        }

        /* Navigation dots (fixed right) */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            top: 50%;

            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(5px, 0.8vh, 9px);
            z-index: 100;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 5px; height: 5px;
            border-radius: 50%;

        .nav-dot.active {

        }
        .nav-dot:hover { background: var(--text-secondary); }

        /* Slide counter (bottom-right) */
        .slide-counter {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            right:  clamp(1rem,   2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        /* Section label (monospace tag above heading) */
        .slide-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            letter-spacing: 0.14em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.35rem, 0.9vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        /* ===================================================
           SCROLL-TRIGGERED REVEAL ANIMATION
           Elements with .reveal start hidden and fade-slide in
           when their parent slide gets .visible from IntersectionObserver
           =================================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(20px);
            transition:
                opacity  0.65s var(--ease-expo),
                transform 0.65s var(--ease-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

        /* Staggered delay for sequential children */
        .reveal:nth-child(1)  { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2)  { transition-delay: 0.14s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3)  { transition-delay: 0.23s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4)  { transition-delay: 0.32s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5)  { transition-delay: 0.41s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6)  { transition-delay: 0.50s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(7)  { transition-delay: 0.59s; }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE SLIDE
           =================================================== */
        .title-slide .slide-content { justify-content: center; }

        .title-tag {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;

        .title-tag::before {

        }

        .main-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);

            line-height: 1.08;

        /* ===================================================

        .pc-blue  .pc-num { color: var(--accent-blue);  }

        .problem-card h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);

            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.55rem);

        .pc-coral h3 { color: var(--accent-coral); }

        .pc-blue  h3 { color: var(--accent-blue);  }

        .callout-box {

        }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 3 — 5-STATE MDP
           =================================================== */
        .mdp-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.6rem);

        }

        .state-id {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.6vw, 1.2rem);

            color: var(--accent-teal);
            min-width: 2em;
            text-align: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            padding-top: 0.05em;
        }

        .state-row h4 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 0.15em;
        }
        .state-row p { font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.45; }

        .mdp-sidebar {
            width: clamp(150px, 22vw, 215px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
        }
        .mdp-sidebar h4 {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 0.9rem);
        }

        .traj-entry { margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.1vh, 0.85rem); }
        .traj-type {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 0.15em 0.5em;
            border-radius: 2px;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-bottom: 0.25em;
        }
        .traj-t1 { background: rgba(0,212,176,0.14); color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .traj-t2 { background: rgba(240,160,32,0.14); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .traj-t3 { background: rgba(255,96,96,0.14);  color: var(--accent-coral); }

        .traj-path {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.92);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            display: block;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .traj-desc {
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.88);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            display: block;
            margin-top: 0.1em;
        }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 4 — THREE QUERY TYPES TABLE
           =================================================== */
        .query-wrap { overflow: hidden; margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem); }

        .query-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
        }
        .query-table th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            text-align: left;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.7rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.07em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .query-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.1vw, 0.85rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-dim);
            vertical-align: top;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .query-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
        .query-table tbody tr:hover td { background: rgba(0,212,176,0.03); }

        .qbadge {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 0.18em 0.55em;
            border-radius: 2px;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .qb-t1 { background: rgba(0,212,176,0.14); color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .qb-t2 { background: rgba(240,160,32,0.14); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .qb-t3 { background: rgba(255,96,96,0.14);  color: var(--accent-coral); }

        .traj-inline {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .ts { /* traj-state */
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            padding: 0.08em 0.32em;
            border-radius: 2px;
            font-size: 0.92em;
        }
        .ta { color: var(--text-muted); margin: 0 0.08em; } /* arrow */

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 5 — DATASET CONSTRUCTION
           =================================================== */
        .pairs-header {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            padding: 0 clamp(0.5rem, 1.3vw, 1rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.5rem);
        }
        .pairs-header span {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .pair-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: clamp(0.35rem, 0.85vh, 0.7rem); margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.55rem); }

        .pair-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            align-items: start;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
        }

        .pr-chosen, .pr-rejected {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.55;
        }
        .pr-chosen   { color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .pr-rejected { color: var(--accent-coral); opacity: 0.82; }

        .pr-lesson {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-style: italic;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .ds-stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 0.9rem);
            padding: clamp(0.45rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            background: rgba(0,212,176,0.045);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        .ds-stat { flex: 1; text-align: center; }
        .ds-stat-val {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 2.2vw, 1.6rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            display: block;
        }
        .ds-stat-lbl { font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-muted); }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 6 — BENCHMARK RESULTS TABLE
           =================================================== */
        .bench-wrap { overflow: hidden; margin-top: clamp(0.25rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem); }

        .bench-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: var(--table-size);
        }
        .bench-table th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--table-size) * 0.88);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            text-align: right;
            padding: clamp(0.22rem, 0.55vw, 0.45rem) clamp(0.35rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .bench-table th:nth-child(1),
        .bench-table th:nth-child(2) { text-align: left; }

        .bench-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.22rem, 0.55vw, 0.42rem) clamp(0.35rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            text-align: right;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            vertical-align: middle;
        }
        .bench-table td:nth-child(1) {
            text-align: left;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-blue);
        }
        .bench-table td:nth-child(2) {
            text-align: left;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* Method-specific row styles */
        .row-dpo-only td:nth-child(2) { color: var(--accent-coral); opacity: 0.80; }
        .row-sft-only  td:nth-child(2) { color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .row-sft-dpo   td:nth-child(2) { color: var(--accent-teal); font-weight: 600; }

        /* Model group separator */
        .group-sep td { border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); padding-top: clamp(0.4rem, 0.9vw, 0.7rem); }

        /* Bold best value per cell */
        .vb  { color: var(--accent-teal); font-weight: 600; }
        /* Highlighted Macro Avg best */
        .vmb {
            background: rgba(0,212,176,0.14);
            border-radius: 2px;
            padding: 0.1em 0.32em;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .table-note {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.7rem, 2vw, 1.2rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.5rem);
        }
        .table-note span {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.35rem;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .tn-swatch {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 10px; height: 10px;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 7 — BAR CHART (LLaMA-3-8B gains)
           =================================================== */
        .chart-layout {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: clamp(180px, 46vh, 340px);
        }

        .chart-divider {
            width: 1px;
            background: var(--border-subtle);
            align-self: stretch;
            margin: 1rem 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .chart-metric {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .chart-title-row {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 0.9rem);
            text-align: center;
        }

        /* Bar area — fixed height, bars grow from bottom */
        .bars-area {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            padding: 2.2em clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem) 0;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        /* Horizontal guide lines */
        .guide-line {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0; right: 0;
            border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
        }
        .guide-line-top {
            top: 0;
            border-top-color: var(--border-subtle);
        }
        .guide-label {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.85);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            transform: translateY(-0.8em);
        }

        .bar-col {
            flex: 1;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: clamp(36px, 10vw, 90px);
            border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
            height: 0;   /* Animated by JS */
            transition: height 1.3s var(--ease-expo);
            position: relative;
        }
        .bar-fill-sft { background: rgba(122,156,197,0.45); }
        .bar-fill-dpo {
            background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--accent-teal) 0%, rgba(0,212,176,0.7) 100%);
            box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,212,176,0.3);
        }

        .bar-val-label {
            position: absolute;
            top: calc(-1 * clamp(1rem, 1.8vh, 1.5rem));
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .bvl-sft { color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .bvl-dpo { color: var(--accent-teal); }

        .bar-row-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.55rem);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .gain-pill {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.3rem;
            background: rgba(0,212,176,0.10);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 2px;
            padding: 0.22em 0.55em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 0.9vh, 0.7rem);
            align-self: center;
        }

        .chart-legend-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 0.9rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .cleg-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4rem;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .cleg-swatch {
            width: 16px; height: 5px;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 8 — KEY TAKEAWAYS
           =================================================== */
        .takeaway-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.35rem, 0.85vh, 0.7rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-teal);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.45rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
        }

        .ta-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            min-width: 1.6em;
        }

        .ta-text { font-size: var(--body-size); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.55; }
        .ta-text strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        .closing-banner {
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 0.9rem);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem) clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
            background: rgba(0,212,176,0.055);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .closing-banner strong { color: var(--accent-teal); }
    </style>
</head>

     SLIDE 1 — TITLE

            Multi-Turn Direct<br>
            Preference Optimization<br>
            for Tool-Augmented LLMs
        </h1>

            Modeling TA-LLM interactions as a 5-state MDP and automatically
            constructing preference trajectory pairs to improve slot-filling
            and tool call rejection — without any human annotation.
        </p>

        <div class="title-tags-row reveal">
            <span class="meta-chip">Direct Preference Optimization</span>
            <span class="meta-chip">Markov Decision Process</span>

<!-- =====================================================
     SLIDE 2 — PROBLEM / MOTIVATION
     ===================================================== -->
<section class="slide" id="slide-2">
    <div class="bg-grid"></div>

    <div class="slide-content">
        <div class="slide-label reveal">Problem · Motivation</div>

        <h2 class="reveal" style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:var(--h2-size);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:clamp(0.3rem,0.8vh,0.6rem);">
            SFT Alone Fails to Teach Slot-Filling and Tool Rejection
        </h2>

        <div class="problem-grid reveal">
            <div class="problem-card pc-coral">
                <div class="pc-num">01</div>
                <h3>Hallucinated Tool Calls</h3>
                <p>SFT-trained models invoke tools even when required arguments are missing, fabricating parameter values rather than pausing to ask.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="problem-card pc-amber">
                <div class="pc-num">02</div>
                <h3>Skipped Clarifications</h3>
                <p>Incomplete queries that need follow-up questions are ignored — the model proceeds with missing slots instead of asking the user for the required information.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="problem-card pc-blue">
                <div class="pc-num">03</div>
                <h3>Wrong Tool Invocation</h3>
                <p>Out-of-scope requests that should be politely rejected are instead routed to unavailable or mismatched tools, producing invalid or incorrect calls.</p>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="callout-box reveal">
            <strong>Root cause:</strong> SFT learns from expert trajectories but has no signal from <em>negative</em> examples — it cannot learn to distinguish correct from incorrect dialogue flows. Direct Preference Optimization provides exactly this contrastive supervision from automatically constructed chosen/rejected pairs.
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="slide-counter">02 / 08</div>
</section>


<!-- =====================================================
     SLIDE 3 — 5-STATE MDP
     ===================================================== -->
<section class="slide" id="slide-3">
    <div class="bg-grid"></div>
    <div class="bg-glow bg-glow-teal" style="width:22vw;height:22vh;top:18%;right:8%;"></div>

    <div class="slide-content">
        <div class="slide-label reveal">Theoretical Foundation</div>

        <h2 class="reveal" style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:var(--h2-size);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:clamp(0.3rem,0.8vh,0.6rem);">
            Modeling TA-LLM Dialogue as a 5-State MDP
        </h2>

        <div class="mdp-layout reveal">
            <div class="mdp-states">
                <div class="state-row">
                    <div class="state-id">S₁</div>
                    <div>
                        <h4>Initial State</h4>
                        <p>No conversation history. Out-of-scope requests return a rejection and remain here (Type 3 self-loop).</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="state-row">
                    <div class="state-id">S₂</div>
                    <div>
                        <h4>Tool Selected — Incomplete Slots</h4>
                        <p>Tool is identified but required parameters are missing. Slot-filling QA interactions occur here; may repeat N times.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="state-row">
                    <div class="state-id">S₃</div>
                    <div>
                        <h4>Tool Selected — All Slots Complete</h4>
                        <p>Both tool selection and all required argument values are fully determined. Ready for execution.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="state-row">
                    <div class="state-id">S₄</div>
                    <div>
                        <h4>Wait for Tool Response</h4>
                        <p>Tool call has been dispatched. System awaits results from the external tool API.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="state-row">
                    <div class="state-id">S₅</div>
                    <div>
                        <h4>Complete</h4>
                        <p>Tool results received. Final completion message generated and returned to the user.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="mdp-sidebar">
                <h4>State Trajectories</h4>

                <div class="traj-entry">
                    <span class="traj-type traj-t1">Type 1</span>
                    <span class="traj-path">S₁ → S₃ → S₄ → S₅</span>
                    <span class="traj-desc">All args present. Direct path.</span>
                </div>

                <div class="traj-entry">
                    <span class="traj-type traj-t2">Type 2</span>
                    <span class="traj-path">S₁ → (S₂×N) → S₃ → S₄ → S₅</span>
                    <span class="traj-desc">Missing args. N slot-filling turns.</span>
                </div>

                <div class="traj-entry">
                    <span class="traj-type traj-t3">Type 3</span>
                    <span class="traj-path">S₁ → S₁</span>
                    <span class="traj-desc">Out-of-scope. Self-loop rejection.</span>
                </div>

                <div style="margin-top:clamp(0.6rem,1.3vh,1rem);padding-top:clamp(0.5rem,1vh,0.8rem);border-top:1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
                    <p style="font-size:calc(var(--small-size)*0.92);color:var(--text-muted);line-height:1.5;">
                        States are <em>latent</em> — inferred from dialogue context, never directly observed by the model.
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="slide-counter">03 / 08</div>
</section>


<!-- =====================================================
     SLIDE 4 — THREE QUERY TYPES TABLE
     ===================================================== -->
<section class="slide" id="slide-4">
    <div class="bg-grid"></div>

    <div class="slide-content">
        <div class="slide-label reveal">Query Classification</div>

        <h2 class="reveal" style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:var(--h2-size);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:clamp(0.4rem,1vh,0.8rem);">
            Three Query Types Define Distinct State Trajectories
        </h2>

        <div class="query-wrap reveal">
            <table class="query-table">
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th style="width:7%">Type</th>
                        <th style="width:20%">Condition</th>
                        <th style="width:26%">State Trajectory</th>
                        <th style="width:30%">Example Query</th>
                        <th style="width:17%">Key Challenge</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    <tr>
                        <td><span class="qbadge qb-t1">Type 1</span></td>
                        <td style="color:var(--text-primary);">All required arguments present</td>
                        <td>
                            <span class="traj-inline">
                                <span class="ts">S₁</span><span class="ta">→</span><span class="ts">S₃</span><span class="ta">→</span><span class="ts">S₄</span><span class="ta">→</span><span class="ts">S₅</span>
                            </span>
                        </td>
                        <td style="color:var(--text-secondary);">"Book a flight from Seoul to Tokyo on March 5th for 2 adults"</td>
                        <td style="color:var(--accent-amber);font-size:var(--small-size);">Avoid redundant slot-filling when all args are present</td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                        <td><span class="qbadge qb-t2">Type 2</span></td>
                        <td style="color:var(--text-primary);">One or more required arguments missing</td>
                        <td>
                            <span class="traj-inline">
                                <span class="ts">S₁</span><span class="ta">→</span><span class="ts">(S₂×N)</span><span class="ta">→</span><span class="ts">S₃</span><span class="ta">→</span><span class="ts">S₄</span><span class="ta">→</span><span class="ts">S₅</span>
                            </span>
                        </td>
                        <td style="color:var(--text-secondary);">"Book a flight to Tokyo" (missing origin, date, passengers)</td>
                        <td style="color:var(--accent-amber);font-size:var(--small-size);">Ask exactly the right follow-up questions, N times</td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                        <td><span class="qbadge qb-t3">Type 3</span></td>
                        <td style="color:var(--text-primary);">No matching tool available</td>
                        <td>
                            <span class="traj-inline">

<script>
    /* =====================================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles: keyboard, touch, wheel navigation;
                intersection observer for reveal animations;
                progress bar and nav dots;
                bar chart animation on entry.
       ===================================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides        = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide  = 0;
            this.barsAnimated  = false;

            this.progressBar   = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsEl     = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.buildNavDots();
            this.setupObserver();
            this.setupKeyboard();
            this.setupTouch();
            this.setupWheel();
        }

        /* --- Navigation dots --- */
        buildNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsEl.appendChild(btn);
            });
        }

        updateDots() {
            this.navDotsEl.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((d, i) => {
                d.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
            });
        }

        /* --- IntersectionObserver: adds .visible class for reveal animations --- */
        setupObserver() {
            const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
                    const slide = entry.target;
                    slide.classList.add('visible');
                    this.currentSlide = this.slides.indexOf(slide);
                    this.updateDots();
                    this.updateProgress();
                    if (slide.id === 'slide-7') {
                        setTimeout(() => this.animateBars(), 250);
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(s => obs.observe(s));
        }

        /* --- Progress bar --- */
        updateProgress() {
            const pct = (this.currentSlide / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100;
            if (this.progressBar) this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* --- Keyboard navigation --- */
        setupKeyboard() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight': case ' ': case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentSlide + 1); break;
                    case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft': case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentSlide - 1); break;
                    case 'Home': e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(0); break;
                    case 'End':  e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1); break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* --- Touch / swipe navigation --- */
        setupTouch() {
            let startY = 0, startX = 0;
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
                startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });
            document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const dx = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 48) {
                    this.goTo(dy > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Mouse wheel navigation (debounced) --- */
        setupWheel() {
            let last = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - last < 750) return;
                last = now;
                this.goTo(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        goTo(idx) {
            if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* --- Bar chart animation (slide 7) ---
             Heights are set as percentages of the bars-area container height.
             The container has an explicit computed height (via clamp), so
             percentage heights on child elements resolve correctly. */
        animateBars() {
            if (this.barsAnimated) return;
            this.barsAnimated = true;

            const set = (id, value) => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.style.height = (value * 100) + '%';
            };

            set('bs-sft', 0.639);
            set('bs-dpo', 0.917);
            set('br-sft', 0.826);
            set('br-dpo', 0.913);
        }
    }

    new SlidePresentation();
</script>
</body>
</html>

            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap:   clamp(0.6rem, 1.4vw, 1.4rem);

            /* Animation easing */
            --ease-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

            /* Glow helpers */
            --glow-teal:  0 0 28px rgba(0, 212, 176, 0.22);
            --glow-amber: 0 0 20px rgba(240, 160, 32,  0.18);
        }

        /* === BASE RESET === */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* ===================================================
           VIEWPORT-BASE.CSS (full contents included inline)
           Mandatory responsive viewport-fitting styles.
           =================================================== */

        html, body { height: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* Each slide = exact viewport height */
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Content container */
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list { gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem); }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li { font-size: var(--body-size); line-height: 1.4; }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* Breakpoint: short viewports < 700px */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.4rem,  1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(1rem,    3vw,   1.75rem);
            }
        }

        /* Breakpoint: very short viewports < 600px */
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem,  2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.3rem,  1vw,   0.75rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1.1rem,  4vw,   2rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.7rem,  1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        /* Breakpoint: landscape phones < 500px */
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw,   1rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1rem,   3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.65rem,1vw,   0.85rem);
            }
        }

        /* Breakpoint: narrow viewports < 600px width */
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* Reduced motion */
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration:  0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s  !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===================================================
           SHARED DECORATIVE / LAYOUT ELEMENTS
           =================================================== */

        /* Subtle grid pattern overlay for all slides */
        .bg-grid {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 212, 176, 0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 212, 176, 0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 64px 64px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* Soft ambient glow blobs */
        .bg-glow {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(90px);
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.45;
        }
        .bg-glow-teal  { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,212,176,0.28)  0%, transparent 70%); }
        .bg-glow-amber { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(240,160,32,0.22) 0%, transparent 70%); }
        .bg-glow-blue  { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(91,164,255,0.18) 0%, transparent 70%); }

        /* Progress bar (fixed top) */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-teal), var(--accent-amber));
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.35s ease;
            box-shadow: var(--glow-teal);
            width: 0;
        }

        /* Navigation dots (fixed right) */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(5px, 0.8vh, 9px);
            z-index: 100;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 5px; height: 5px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            border: none;
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
            padding: 0;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-teal);
            transform: scale(1.6);
            box-shadow: var(--glow-teal);
        }
        .nav-dot:hover { background: var(--text-secondary); }

        /* Slide counter (bottom-right) */
        .slide-counter {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            right:  clamp(1rem,   2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        /* Section label (monospace tag above heading) */
        .slide-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            letter-spacing: 0.14em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.35rem, 0.9vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        /* ===================================================
           SCROLL-TRIGGERED REVEAL ANIMATION
           Elements with .reveal start hidden and fade-slide in
           when their parent slide gets .visible from IntersectionObserver
           =================================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(20px);
            transition:
                opacity  0.65s var(--ease-expo),
                transform 0.65s var(--ease-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

        /* Staggered delay for sequential children */
        .reveal:nth-child(1)  { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2)  { transition-delay: 0.14s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3)  { transition-delay: 0.23s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4)  { transition-delay: 0.32s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5)  { transition-delay: 0.41s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6)  { transition-delay: 0.50s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(7)  { transition-delay: 0.59s; }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE SLIDE
           =================================================== */
        .title-slide .slide-content { justify-content: center; }

        .title-tag {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            background: rgba(0, 212, 176, 0.08);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: 0.28em 0.75em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vh, 1.4rem);
            width: fit-content;
        }
        .title-tag::before {
            content: '';
            width: 6px; height: 6px;
            background: var(--accent-teal);
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow: var(--glow-teal);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .main-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.08;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vh, 1.4rem);
            max-width: 88%;
        }
        .main-title .hl-teal  { color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .main-title .hl-amber { color: var(--accent-amber); }

        .title-sub {
            font-size: clamp(0.82rem, 1.6vw, 1.1rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 300;
            max-width: 62%;
            line-height: 1.65;
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 2.5vh, 2rem);
        }

        .title-tags-row {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
        }
        .meta-chip {
            display: inline-block;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-dim);
            border-radius: 2px;
            padding: 0.25em 0.7em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 2 — PROBLEM / MOTIVATION
           =================================================== */
        .problem-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.3vw, 1.1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.9rem);
        }

        .problem-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.65rem, 1.8vw, 1.3rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .problem-card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 2px;
        }
        .pc-coral::after  { background: var(--accent-coral); }
        .pc-amber::after  { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .pc-blue::after   { background: var(--accent-blue);  }

        .pc-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.2vw, 2.8rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            opacity: 0.10;
            position: absolute;
            top: 0.15em; right: 0.3em;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .pc-coral .pc-num { color: var(--accent-coral); }
        .pc-amber .pc-num { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .pc-blue  .pc-num { color: var(--accent-blue);  }

        .problem-card h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.55rem);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }
        .pc-coral h3 { color: var(--accent-coral); }
        .pc-amber h3 { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .pc-blue  h3 { color: var(--accent-blue);  }

        .problem-card p { font-size: var(--body-size); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.55; }

        .callout-box {
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 0.9rem);
            padding: clamp(0.45rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.3rem);
            background: rgba(240, 160, 32, 0.07);
            border: 1px solid rgba(240, 160, 32, 0.22);
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .callout-box strong { color: var(--accent-amber); }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 3 — 5-STATE MDP
           =================================================== */
        .mdp-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.6rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
            align-items: start;
        }

        .mdp-states { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: clamp(0.35rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem); }

        .state-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.45rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
        }

        .state-id {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.6vw, 1.2rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            min-width: 2em;
            text-align: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            padding-top: 0.05em;
        }

        .state-row h4 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 0.15em;
        }
        .state-row p { font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.45; }

        .mdp-sidebar {
            width: clamp(150px, 22vw, 215px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
        }
        .mdp-sidebar h4 {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 0.9rem);
        }

        .traj-entry { margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.1vh, 0.85rem); }
        .traj-type {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 0.15em 0.5em;
            border-radius: 2px;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-bottom: 0.25em;
        }
        .traj-t1 { background: rgba(0,212,176,0.14); color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .traj-t2 { background: rgba(240,160,32,0.14); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .traj-t3 { background: rgba(255,96,96,0.14);  color: var(--accent-coral); }

        .traj-path {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.92);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            display: block;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .traj-desc {
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.88);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            display: block;
            margin-top: 0.1em;
        }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 4 — THREE QUERY TYPES TABLE
           =================================================== */
        .query-wrap { overflow: hidden; margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem); }

        .query-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
        }
        .query-table th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            text-align: left;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.7rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.07em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .query-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.1vw, 0.85rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-dim);
            vertical-align: top;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .query-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
        .query-table tbody tr:hover td { background: rgba(0,212,176,0.03); }

        .qbadge {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 0.18em 0.55em;
            border-radius: 2px;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .qb-t1 { background: rgba(0,212,176,0.14); color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .qb-t2 { background: rgba(240,160,32,0.14); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .qb-t3 { background: rgba(255,96,96,0.14);  color: var(--accent-coral); }

        .traj-inline {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .ts { /* traj-state */
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            padding: 0.08em 0.32em;
            border-radius: 2px;
            font-size: 0.92em;
        }
        .ta { color: var(--text-muted); margin: 0 0.08em; } /* arrow */

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 5 — DATASET CONSTRUCTION
           =================================================== */
        .pairs-header {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            padding: 0 clamp(0.5rem, 1.3vw, 1rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.5rem);
        }
        .pairs-header span {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .pair-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: clamp(0.35rem, 0.85vh, 0.7rem); margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.55rem); }

        .pair-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            align-items: start;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
        }

        .pr-chosen, .pr-rejected {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            line-height: 1.55;
        }
        .pr-chosen   { color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .pr-rejected { color: var(--accent-coral); opacity: 0.82; }

        .pr-lesson {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-style: italic;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .ds-stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 0.9rem);
            padding: clamp(0.45rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            background: rgba(0,212,176,0.045);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        .ds-stat { flex: 1; text-align: center; }
        .ds-stat-val {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 2.2vw, 1.6rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            display: block;
        }
        .ds-stat-lbl { font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-muted); }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 6 — BENCHMARK RESULTS TABLE
           =================================================== */
        .bench-wrap { overflow: hidden; margin-top: clamp(0.25rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem); }

        .bench-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: var(--table-size);
        }
        .bench-table th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--table-size) * 0.88);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            text-align: right;
            padding: clamp(0.22rem, 0.55vw, 0.45rem) clamp(0.35rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .bench-table th:nth-child(1),
        .bench-table th:nth-child(2) { text-align: left; }

        .bench-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.22rem, 0.55vw, 0.42rem) clamp(0.35rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            text-align: right;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            vertical-align: middle;
        }
        .bench-table td:nth-child(1) {
            text-align: left;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-blue);
        }
        .bench-table td:nth-child(2) {
            text-align: left;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* Method-specific row styles */
        .row-dpo-only td:nth-child(2) { color: var(--accent-coral); opacity: 0.80; }
        .row-sft-only  td:nth-child(2) { color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .row-sft-dpo   td:nth-child(2) { color: var(--accent-teal); font-weight: 600; }

        /* Model group separator */
        .group-sep td { border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); padding-top: clamp(0.4rem, 0.9vw, 0.7rem); }

        /* Bold best value per cell */
        .vb  { color: var(--accent-teal); font-weight: 600; }
        /* Highlighted Macro Avg best */
        .vmb {
            background: rgba(0,212,176,0.14);
            border-radius: 2px;
            padding: 0.1em 0.32em;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .table-note {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.7rem, 2vw, 1.2rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.5rem);
        }
        .table-note span {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.35rem;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .tn-swatch {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 10px; height: 10px;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        /* ===================================================
           SLIDE 7 — BAR CHART (LLaMA-3-8B gains)
           =================================================== */
        .chart-layout {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: clamp(180px, 46vh, 340px);
        }

        .chart-divider {
            width: 1px;
            background: var(--border-subtle);
            align-self: stretch;
            margin: 1rem 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .chart-metric {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .chart-title-row {
            font-family: var(--font-display);

        </h2>

                <div class="pc-num">01</div>

            </div>
            <div class="problem-card pc-amber">
                <div class="pc-num">02</div>
                <h3>Skipped Clarifications</h3>
                <p>Incomplete queries that need follow-up questions are ignored — the model proceeds with missing slots instead of asking the user for the required information.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="problem-card pc-blue">
                <div class="pc-num">03</div>
                <h3>Wrong Tool Invocation</h3>
                <p>Out-of-scope requests that should be politely rejected are instead routed to unavailable or mismatched tools, producing invalid or incorrect calls.</p>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="callout-box reveal">
            <strong>Root cause:</strong> SFT learns from expert trajectories but has no signal from <em>negative</em> examples — it cannot learn to distinguish correct from incorrect dialogue flows. Direct Preference Optimization provides exactly this contrastive supervision from automatically constructed chosen/rejected pairs.

<!-- =====================================================
     SLIDE 3 — 5-STATE MDP
     ===================================================== -->
<section class="slide" id="slide-3">
    <div class="bg-grid"></div>
    <div class="bg-glow bg-glow-teal" style="width:22vw;height:22vh;top:18%;right:8%;"></div>

            Modeling TA-LLM Dialogue as a 5-State MDP
        </h2>

        <div class="mdp-layout reveal">
            <div class="mdp-states">
                <div class="state-row">
                    <div class="state-id">S₁</div>
                    <div>
                        <h4>Initial State</h4>
                        <p>No conversation history. Out-of-scope requests return a rejection and remain here (Type 3 self-loop).</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="state-row">
                    <div class="state-id">S₂</div>
                    <div>
                        <h4>Tool Selected — Incomplete Slots</h4>
                        <p>Tool is identified but required parameters are missing. Slot-filling QA interactions occur here; may repeat N times.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="state-row">
                    <div class="state-id">S₃</div>
                    <div>
                        <h4>Tool Selected — All Slots Complete</h4>
                        <p>Both tool selection and all required argument values are fully determined. Ready for execution.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="state-row">
                    <div class="state-id">S₄</div>
                    <div>
                        <h4>Wait for Tool Response</h4>
                        <p>Tool call has been dispatched. System awaits results from the external tool API.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="state-row">
                    <div class="state-id">S₅</div>
                    <div>
                        <h4>Complete</h4>
                        <p>Tool results received. Final completion message generated and returned to the user.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="mdp-sidebar">
                <h4>State Trajectories</h4>

                <div class="traj-entry">
                    <span class="traj-type traj-t1">Type 1</span>
                    <span class="traj-path">S₁ → S₃ → S₄ → S₅</span>
                    <span class="traj-desc">All args present. Direct path.</span>
                </div>

                <div class="traj-entry">
                    <span class="traj-type traj-t2">Type 2</span>
                    <span class="traj-path">S₁ → (S₂×N) → S₃ → S₄ → S₅</span>
                    <span class="traj-desc">Missing args. N slot-filling turns.</span>
                </div>

                <div class="traj-entry">
                    <span class="traj-type traj-t3">Type 3</span>
                    <span class="traj-path">S₁ → S₁</span>
                    <span class="traj-desc">Out-of-scope. Self-loop rejection.</span>
                </div>

                <div style="margin-top:clamp(0.6rem,1.3vh,1rem);padding-top:clamp(0.5rem,1vh,0.8rem);border-top:1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
                    <p style="font-size:calc(var(--small-size)*0.92);color:var(--text-muted);line-height:1.5;">
                        States are <em>latent</em> — inferred from dialogue context, never directly observed by the model.
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="slide-counter">03 / 08</div>
</section>
